eats.open_evidence: Own website says it is "NOW open for the 2026 season" and lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Domini Sandwiches
eats.what_to_order: A deli sandwich such as the Reuben, pastrami or roast beef; the site says the menu is basic, with house-roasted meats and fresh-baked bread.
eats.why: A downtown Spokane sandwich shop that dates to 1963; per the Inlander (November 2024) the owner retired and passed it to longtime employees.
eats.hours_note: Monday to Friday 10am-2:30pm, closed Saturday and Sunday (own website, no year shown).
eats.open_evidence: Spokesman-Review (23 September 2026) lists it among current Spokane eats as reopened in 2025 under new ownership; own site lists Monday-Friday hours but shows no year (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Cottage Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Chicken fried steak and eggs (per the Spokesman-Review); the cafe's own site says clam chowder is served on Fridays in fall and winter.
eats.why: In the neighbouring city of Spokane Valley rather than Spokane itself; a one-location breakfast and lunch cafe open daily.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week 7am-2pm; closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day, closes early on their eves, opens 8am on New Year's Day (own website).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and links a menu file named for 2026, and the Spokesman-Review of 23 September 2026 lists it with 7 AM-2 PM daily hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Riptide Waterfront Cafe
eats.what_to_order: An island-inspired breakfast sandwich with locally roasted coffee or espresso, or a fresh-baked pastry.
eats.why: A waterfront cafe at 10 Front Street in Friday Harbor that has served the island since 2016, a quick breakfast after the Day 2 ferry crossing.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal hours: the homepage says open 7am to 2pm every day, but its footer says 7am to 5pm daily; the page says it is open for the season.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and says it is open for the season (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Bakery San Juan
eats.what_to_order: Sourdough pizza by the slice, sourdough bread or a sandwich; the page also lists breakfast pastries and pies.
eats.why: An island bakery in Friday Harbor, established 2008, baking sourdough breads and pizzas.
eats.hours_note: Monday to Friday 8am-5pm, closed Saturday and Sunday (own website, no year shown).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with no seasonal closure notice, but the page shows no year (copyright line has no date); weaker evidence than a dated page (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Orcas Bakery
eats.what_to_order: Handmade sourdough bread and baked goods; the page names no specific items beyond that.
eats.why: Daily alternative to Brown Bear Baking, which is closed Tuesday to Thursday; the page says it bakes sourdough with local Pacific Northwest ingredients.
eats.hours_note: Open every day 8am-3pm per its own website; the Orcas Island Chamber food and drink guide (undated) also lists daily 8am-3pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and the Orcas Island Chamber of Commerce guide agrees, but neither shows a year; weaker evidence than a dated page (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Lower Tavern
eats.what_to_order: A burger (Best Burger, Black & Bleu, Patty Melt or Salmon Burger are named) or fish & chips.
eats.why: A sports tavern at 46 Prune Alley in Eastsound that serves a full kitchen daily; it is one of three local restaurants under the same ownership alongside Blackfish Cafe and Harbor Bar & Grill.
eats.hours_note: Kitchen 11AM-10PM daily; bar open until 2AM (own website).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current kitchen hours and carries a 2026 copyright (viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: The NPS lists 2026 in-park dining dates of May 1 to October 12 for the Old Faithful Inn Dining Room and Bear Paw Deli, May 15 to October 25 for the Canyon Lodge Eatery and Lounge, and April 17 to October 31 (then December 15 to March 15) for the Old Faithful Snow Lodge Geyser Grill, and says all dates are subject to change without advance notice. Our advice: the eats below are in and around Jackson, not inside Yellowstone, so on the Lamar Valley, Canyon and Old Faithful days check the NPS dates for the year you travel and bring your own lunch.

eats.name: The Bunnery Bakery & Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast or lunch plus items from the bakery, which the site says is fresh daily; the page names no individual dishes.
eats.why: A bakery-restaurant at 130 N. Cache Street, half a block from Town Square, so it works as a breakfast stop before a Teton day.
eats.hours_note: Site lists breakfast 7:00-11:30 and lunch 11:30-3:00; no dinner service is listed on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists breakfast and lunch hours and carries a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Persephone Bakery & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Pastries, bread and coffee; the site says the coffee comes from local Jackson Hole Roasters.
eats.why: A Jackson Hole bakery group with three sites (Persephone Jackson, Persephone Westbank and Picnic) that says its food is sourced from over 20 regional farms and ranches.
eats.hours_note: Site says all cafes are open daily; the page fetched gives no hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says 'ALL CAFES ARE NOW OPEN DAILY', offers online ordering and carries a 'Copyright 2026' footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Nora's Fish Creek Inn
eats.what_to_order: Huevos Rancheros, which the site calls the restaurant's famous dish; breakfast is served all day.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Wilson rather than Jackson itself. A single-location restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch and dinner seven days a week, with daily dinner specials such as Prime Rib and Fish 'n Chips.
eats.hours_note: Site lists open 7 days a week: breakfast 6:30am-2pm, lunch 11am-2pm, dinner 5pm-9pm. The site's page title reads 'Nora's Homestyle Kitchen & Bar' while its logo and footer say 'Nora's Fish Creek Inn'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, daily dinner specials and a live-music schedule, with a 2026 copyright footer and no closure or seasonal notice (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Ranch Eats Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The rotating daily menu; the Wyoming Tribune Eagle article mentions broccoli cheese soup, pulled pork quesadillas, the Cowboy Meets Alien Burger and pastries baked fresh daily.
eats.why: A downtown cafe at 1920 Thomes Ave inside the City Center Building that grew out of a 2022 food truck and uses local beef and Josie's Creamery ice cream, per the Wyoming Tribune Eagle.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Friday 8am-2pm (the June 2025 opening article said weekdays from 7am); closed weekends per that article.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current cafe hours and online ordering but its footer reads 'Copyright 2024'; Wyoming Tribune Eagle article on the downtown opening dated June 3, 2025 (page shows an update of July 9, 2026) (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Albany Restaurant, Bar & Liquor Mart
eats.what_to_order: Hand-cut steaks and slow-roasted meats; the Chamber listing says soups, gravies, salad dressings and specials are made from scratch.
eats.why: A family-owned downtown restaurant and bar at 1506 Capitol Ave that Cheyenne's tourism board lists as opened in 1942.
eats.hours_note: Chamber listing: restaurant 11am-2pm lunch and 5pm-9pm dinner; closed Sundays. The listing carries no year, so confirm by phone, (307) 638-3507.
eats.open_evidence: Cheyenne Chamber of Commerce member listing gives current hours and phone, and the Cheyenne tourism board's local-eats page lists it as family owned; neither page shows a year, so this is weaker evidence (viewed 2026-10-14).
eats.source_name: Cheyenne Chamber of Commerce member listing

stops.note: The NPS says there are no restaurants or food options inside Devils Tower National Monument; Hulett is 10 miles north and Sundance 30 miles southeast, and Devils Tower View, one mile south of the monument, is open year round with a small restaurant (page last updated April 24, 2025).

eats.name: Longhorn Saloon & Grill
eats.what_to_order: Steak; the site calls it a steakhouse serving the best cuts of local beef.
eats.why: A family-run steakhouse at 214 Main in Sundance, run by Charity and Josh McLaughlin, and called Etta's Place until it was renamed in 2013, per the Sundance Times.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists open daily 11am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours but shows only a 2022 copyright; Sundance Times of Aug 21, 2025 reports the owners and a filming date at the restaurant, and its March 26, 2026 legal notice lists Longhorn Saloon & Grill, LLC applying to renew its 2026/2027 liquor license (viewed 2026-10-14).
